title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

The shock to Long Treasury yield from “The Fed raises by a half point or more on December 9”

On Nov 10 the 10-year rose 10bp for a 17bp move in the 2-year (CNN, 'Bond yields surge most in 19 months'); hawkish Fed news this month has flattened the curve, so I carry about 6bp to the long end.
